assumptions.statement: The submission uses the maintainer provisional overall-design polygon because the official polygon is not in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics, diagrams and design layers are intake values and must be regenerated after the official polygon is supplied.
assumptions.required_next_action: Replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson from an official or cleared file with version, CRS and license recorded.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 is retained exactly as supplied; its relationship to Dazhongsi Station and road anchors is unresolved in public data, as discussed in Issue #1029.
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi station integration is a conceptual interface only; no distance, four-quadrant boundary or station engineering conclusion is asserted.
assumptions.required_next_action: Re-anchor all three key areas only after maintainers publish an official or cleared polygon and anchor relationship.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, setbacks, road redlines, fire access, municipal capacity, ownership and heritage controls are missing.
assumptions.impact: The package uses functional structure, concept footprints and service interfaces rather than statutory controls or engineering conclusions.
assumptions.required_next_action: Load approved regulatory conditions, survey, ownership, heritage and infrastructure attachments before statutory or implementation use.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept siting studies generated inside the provisional site polygon, not a survey of existing building footprints.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/new-build labels are design hypotheses and cannot be read as parcel-level demolition or approval decisions.
assumptions.required_next_action: Replace with cleared existing-building survey and ownership-aware update categories.

assumptions.statement: No field walk, resident survey, accessibility audit, traffic count or authorized AI pilot is claimed as completed.
assumptions.impact: Three validation scenarios define pre-pilot baseline fields, success and stop conditions, human fallback and responsible review, but contain no invented performance numbers.
assumptions.required_next_action: Obtain authorization, freeze a baseline protocol, run human-reviewed pilot, record results and publish only cleared aggregates.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection and construction-control polygons for railway remnants and related resources are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: AI pilgrimage landmarks are conceptual, reversible and low-impact suggestions; no construction or heritage-control conclusion is made.
assumptions.required_next_action: Obtain official heritage protection and construction-control data before detailed public-space or building design.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer community operations and scenario opening are proposed operating patterns, not confirmed schedules, funding or government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: The proposal can be tested by a professional operator without implying a commitment.
assumptions.required_next_action: Define operator, permissions, budget, safety review, data governance and public feedback route for each pilot.

assumptions.statement: The package uses repository public or user-cleared material and agent-generated design geometry; no private data, confidential map, third-party image or external map tile is embedded.
assumptions.impact: Visual and evidence assets remain locally auditable and redistributable under the stated display license.
assumptions.required_next_action: Recheck rights and source hashes whenever a new public or user-provided asset is added.
